outcome: Maternal symptoms (headache, blurring of vision, epigastric pain)
cohort: The study included 94 admitted patients with preeclampsia/eclampsia, with a median age of 23 years, at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The occurrence and severity of hypertensive retinopathy increased significantly with the severity of HDP and were associated with increased maternal symptoms and fetal morbidity (preterm deliveries, neonatal mortality, and SGA).
